[{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"Authentication, Authorization (Pundit), and Encrypted Credentials in Ruby on Rails"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"Securing a Ruby on Rails application involves three critical pillars: Authentication (proving who the user is), Authorization (proving what the user is allowed to do), and Secure Configuration (protecting API keys and credentials). This tutorial covers implementing authentication from scratch or via Devise, setting up authorization using Pundit, and managing secrets using Rails encrypted credentials."},{"order":3,"type":"subheading","text":"1. Authentication Setup"},{"order":4,"type":"paragraph","text":"Authentication handles user sign-up, login, and session management. In modern Rails, you can build this usinghas_secure_password or utilize the standard Devise gem. Below is a quick implementation using has_secure_password."},{"order":5,"type":"code","text":"rails g model User email:string password_digest:string role:string
rails db:migrate"},{"order":6,"type":"paragraph","text":"Next, configure the User model to include the secure password module and set default roles."},{"order":7,"type":"code","text":"class User < ApplicationRecord
  has_secure_password
  validates :email, presence: true, uniqueness: true
  
  enum role: { member: 'member', admin: 'admin' }
end"},{"order":8,"type":"subheading","text":"2. Authorization with Pundit"},{"order":9,"type":"paragraph","text":"While authentication answers 'Who are you?', Pundit answers 'Are you allowed to do this?'. Pundit relies heavily on plain Ruby classes rather than complex DSLs. Add the pundit gem to your Gemfile and run bundle install."},{"order":10,"type":"code","text":"gem 'pundit'
bundle install"},{"order":11,"type":"paragraph","text":"Include Pundit in your ApplicationController to manage authorization context across your application."},{"order":12,"type":"code","text":"class ApplicationController < ActionController::Base
  include Pundit::Authorization
  
  rescue_from Pundit::NotAuthorizedError, with: :user_not_authorized

  private

  def user_not_authorized
    flash[:alert] = 'You are not authorized to perform this action.'
    redirect_to(request.referer || root_path)
  end
end"},{"order":13,"type":"paragraph","text":"Generate a policy for an Article resource to define specific access rules."},{"order":14,"type":"code","text":"rails g pundit:policy article"},{"order":15,"type":"paragraph","text":"Define the authorization rules inside app/policies/article_policy.rb."},{"order":16,"type":"code","text":"class ArticlePolicy < ApplicationPolicy
  attr_reader :user, :article

  def initialize(user, article)
    @user = user
    @article = article
  end

  def update?
    user.admin? || article.user_id == user.id
  end

  def destroy?
    user.admin?
  end
end"},{"order":17,"type":"subheading","text":"3. Managing Secrets with Encrypted Credentials"},{"order":18,"type":"paragraph","text":"Never hardcode API keys or database passwords. Rails provides built-in encrypted credentials storage using a master key and a YAML file."},{"order":19,"type":"code","text":"EDITOR="nano" rails credentials:edit"},{"order":20,"type":"paragraph","text":"Add your secret configuration parameters inside the YAML file that opens:"},{"order":21,"type":"code","text":"aws:
  access_key_id: 'your_access_key'
  secret_access_key: 'your_secret_key'

stripe:
  api_key: 'sk_test_12345'"},{"order":22,"type":"paragraph","text":"You can now safely access these encrypted values anywhere in your application using Rails.application.credentials."},{"order":23,"type":"code","text":"stripe_key = Rails.application.credentials.dig(:stripe, :api_key)"},{"order":24,"type":"subheading","text":"Conclusion"},{"order":25,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Authentication ensures identity tracking via session management or tokens."},{"order":26,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Pundit isolates authorization logic into clean, testable Ruby policy objects."},{"order":27,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Encrypted credentials protect sensitive keys in version control while keeping deployments seamless."}]
